structure: Single-grade Vermont draft framework document (Grade 5 - World Geography and Ancient Civilizations I). Front matter: header banner, title, Overview narrative, Looking Back/Looking Ahead, Inquiry rationale and contact. Inquiry: 'Critical Proficiency (K-12)' Inquiry Process statement and three Priority Performance Indicators for grades 3-5 (Constructing Compelling and Supporting Questions; Gathering and Evaluating Sources; Communicating and Critiquing Solutions), then Overarching Themes. Body is organized by four subject sections (Civics, Economics, Geography, History); each opens with a K-12 'Critical Proficiency' statement and a 'Theme:' line, followed by 3-column tables: R1 headers 'Priority Performance Indicator (PPI)' | 'Sample PPI Connections' | 'Sample Content Connections'; each later row = one C3 strand (strand name + PPI text with D2 dimension numbers in C1; 'Students will be able to...' expectations in C2; bulleted sample content in C3). Rows continued over pages show '(continued)'. Each subject ends with a 'Resources' list. No state-specific standard codes. Labeling: title, themes, critical proficiency, PPIs (C1) and 'Students will' expectations (C2) = standards; sample content (C3), Overview narrative and Resources = examples; Looking Back/Ahead, inquiry rationale, 'not in this grade' notes and 'Intentionally blank' cells = backup.
